Gate 8 security replayed it on pg18: held writer lock fails at 3s with v2 intact, SET LOCAL does not leak.

trigger: a non-FK census upsert error (lock timeout, trigger) keeps the event but leaves the census row stale; a Redelivered event never repairs it
summary: Pre-existing residual class, tracked in #5718 and the locked PR2 design: a non-FK census upsert error (lock timeout, trigger) keeps the event but leaves the census row stale; a Redelivered event never repairs it; after a rule delete and recreate under the same id, redelivered old-incarnation events can seed the new rule census (PR2 scope, D2 ruling). PR1 strictly improves it (error log, counter, event/census atomicity) and the owner ruling keeps repair out of PR1 ("PR1 adds NO repair"). The facts still derive HIGH (I3, E5): a stale census is presented as current. Recorded OPEN at the derived band, NOT waived: releasing it needs a non-author adjudication by the owner (see the run report). Not parked, not linked: I3 findings may not take the roadmap disposition.
